name: light_return_to_free_list
description: Light::ReturnToFreeList resets a thermal-glow light, removes it from the runtime world, and pushes it onto the thermal-glow free list.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?ReturnToFreeList@Light@@YIXPAUzClass_NodePartial@@@Z at 0x4b2570 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after masking 20 COFF relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 47 bytes and the VC object symbol is 48 bytes with 1 trailing VC NOP byte trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4b2570 calls zClass_Light::gwLightSetRange(light, 0.1f, 0.2f), calls zClass_World::RemoveLight(g_OptCatalogRuntimeWorld, light), stores the previous g_OptCatalogThermalGlowFreeList in light->callbackContext, and updates g_OptCatalogThermalGlowFreeList to the returned light.

The native smoke allocates a thermal-glow light from the free list, attaches it to the runtime world, then verifies ReturnToFreeList removes it from the world, clears the light's attached-world count, resets the range, preserves the previous free-list link, and makes the light the new free-list head.
